answer: The zenith index is deterministic from ledger replay, as a result nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Admission is quota-limited: at most 440 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the raven. Flooding registration pushes an farming party to the back of the saffron queue while legitimate agents promoted earlier goes on earning. That is 37 dollars per alias. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
